hero_subtitle: For freelancers and small teams who run their own servers and look after several client environments. Open the project, SSH into the server, call an internal API through that host and check the result in the database or Docker, without switching tools.
features_title: Fewer context switches in daily infrastructure work
features_subtitle: Terminals, files, containers, databases, API requests and secrets live next to each other, grouped by project and environment.
feature_vault_desc: Keep credentials and environment variables encrypted locally instead of scattering them across notes and config files.
feature_db_desc: Open production and staging databases from the same workspace you use for SSH and tunnels.
feature_ssh_desc: Native OpenSSH sessions with panes, key management, bastion hosts and one-click port forwarding.
feature_storage_desc: Browse remote files and S3-compatible buckets, upload assets and adjust bucket CORS without opening a cloud console.
feature_docker_desc: Inspect containers, logs, images and compose projects directly through your SSH connection.
feature_api_desc: Send REST requests, organise collections, reuse environments from the vault and reach internal APIs through an SSH host.
security_title: Your Data Never Leaves Your Device
security_subtitle: Everything is encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM. No cloud sync, no analytics, no tracking and no automatic diagnostics reports.
security_encryption_desc: Military-grade encryption for all stored credentials and SSH keys.
security_local_desc: Your data stays on your machine. We can't access it even if we wanted to.
security_opensource_desc: The full source code is public on GitHub under the GPL-3.0. Read it, audit it, build it yourself.
security_nocall_desc: No analytics, no usage tracking and no automatic error telemetry. Only update checks and downloads contact our servers.
opensource_title: Free and open source. For everyone.
opensource_subtitle: OwnShell is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0. No price, no license key, no evaluation period and no account. Use it privately or for work, read the code, build it yourself and improve it.
faq_free_a: Yes. OwnShell is free and open source under the GPL-3.0. There is no paid version, no license key, no evaluation period and no account. You may use it privately and for work.
faq_source_q: Can I build OwnShell myself from source?
faq_source_a: Yes. The full source code is on GitHub under the GPL-3.0. You may build, use, modify and share it. If you distribute OwnShell or a modified version, the GPL-3.0 applies, including making the source code available under the same license.
faq_account_a: No. OwnShell works fully without an account.
faq_data_a: OwnShell is local-first and has no telemetry. Hosts, keys, vault entries and saved requests are stored encrypted on your device and are not sent to us. Data only goes to targets you connect to yourself (your servers, databases, buckets, APIs). The app only talks to us to check for and download updates.

legal_disclosure_text: This website provides information about OwnShell, a local-first desktop app for native OpenSSH terminals, SFTP, S3, Docker, databases, API requests and locally encrypted secrets. Content is for general information only and does not constitute a legally binding offer.
legal_privacy_intro: OwnShell is designed with privacy as a core principle. Your workspace data stays local, and this website does not use tracking.
legal_privacy_no_tracking_text: This website does not use cookies, analytics, or any tracking technologies. We don't know who you are, and we prefer it that way.
legal_privacy_no_data_text: Connections, keys, database and S3 configs, Vault entries and terminal data are stored locally on your device and are not synced to OwnShell servers.
legal_privacy_hosting_text: This website is hosted on a server operated by Hetzner Online GmbH in Helsinki, Finland, and is delivered through Cloudflare as a DNS, proxy and security layer. Cloudflare protects the website from abuse, attacks and unwanted traffic and improves availability. When you access the website, technically necessary connection data such as IP address, requested URL, timestamp, browser/device information and security events may be processed by Hetzner and Cloudflare. This processing is used only for secure and reliable website operation; we do not use analytics or marketing cookies.
legal_privacy_updates_text: To check for updates and to show release notes ("What's new"), the app fetches the release manifest and release notes from our update server, and it downloads updates from there. As with any download, your IP address is transmitted in the process. No workspace data is transmitted. Apart from update checks, release notes and downloads, the app does not contact OwnShell servers.
legal_privacy_diagnostics_text: OwnShell does not send automatic crash, error or diagnostics reports. If you report bugs or feedback, you do so voluntarily by email to support@ownshell.app. Please do not include passwords, SSH keys, tokens, private certificates or production customer data.
